description: TypeScript interface defining the IBillingProviderService with methods for billing, customer, subscription, invoice management, and related operations in a Stripe-based billing system.

methods.name: checkoutSessionIsPaid
methods.description: Checks if a payment session identified by paymentId has been paid.

methods.name: handleSubscriptionCancel
methods.description: Handles the cancellation of a subscription by its ID.

methods.name: handleSubscriptionCreation
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new subscription.

methods.name: handleSubscriptionUpdate
methods.description: Updates a subscription with provided details such as membership count and proration behavior.

methods.name: handleEndTrial
methods.description: Ends the trial period for a subscription.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer with email and optional metadata.

methods.name: createPaymentIntent
methods.description: Creates a payment intent for a customer with specified amount and metadata.

methods.name: createSubscriptionCheckout
methods.description: Creates a checkout session for subscribing a customer to a plan.

methods.name: createPrice
methods.description: Creates a new price object with specified amount, currency, interval, and product.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Retrieves a price object by its ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current status of a subscription.

methods.name: getCheckoutSession
methods.description: Retrieves a checkout session by its ID.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves customer details by customer ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Lists subscriptions for a customer.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates customer information.

methods.name: createInvoiceItem
methods.description: Creates an invoice item for a customer.

methods.name: deleteInvoiceItem
methods.description: Deletes an invoice item by its ID.

methods.name: createInvoice
methods.description: Creates an invoice for a customer.

methods.name: finalizeInvoice
methods.description: Finalizes an invoice and provides its URL.

methods.name: voidInvoice
methods.description: Voids an invoice.

methods.name: getPaymentIntentFailureReason
methods.description: Retrieves the failure reason for a payment intent.

methods.name: hasDefaultPaymentMethod
methods.description: Checks if a customer has a default payment method.

methods.name: createSubscriptionUsageRecord
methods.description: Creates a usage record for a subscription.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves details of a subscription.

methods.name: listInvoices
methods.description: Lists invoices for a customer, optionally filtered by subscription and date range.
